enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng
enemy.en: What time did you get up today?
enemy.fr: Tu t'es levé à quelle heure aujourd'hui ?

player.pinyin: wǒ qī diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le
player.en: I got up at seven.
player.fr: Je me suis levé à sept heures.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ zǎo shang yào shàng bān ma
enemy.en: Do you have work this morning?
enemy.fr: Tu travailles ce matin ?

player.pinyin: duì wǒ bā diǎn shàng bān
player.en: Yes, I start at eight.
player.fr: Oui, je commence à huit heures.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān gōng zuò máng bù máng
enemy.en: Is work busy today?
enemy.fr: Le travail est chargé aujourd'hui ?

player.pinyin: hěn máng wǒ hěn lèi
player.en: Very busy, I'm exhausted.
player.fr: Très chargé, je suis épuisé.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ zhōng wǔ chī le shén me
enemy.en: What did you have for lunch?
enemy.fr: Tu as mangé quoi à midi ?

player.pinyin: wǒ zhōng wǔ chī miàn hěn hǎo chī
player.en: I had noodles for lunch, they were delicious.
player.fr: J'ai mangé des nouilles à midi, c'était délicieux.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ wǎn shang xiǎng zuò shén me
enemy.en: What do you want to do tonight?
enemy.fr: Tu veux faire quoi ce soir ?

player.pinyin: wǒ wǎn shang xiǎng zài jiā xiū xi
player.en: I want to rest at home tonight.
player.fr: Je veux me reposer à la maison ce soir.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān xià bān le ma
enemy.en: Are you done with work today?
enemy.fr: Tu as fini le travail aujourd'hui ?

player.pinyin: xià bān le wǒ yào qù chī fàn
player.en: Done, I'm going to go eat.
player.fr: Fini, je vais aller manger.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ zuó tiān jǐ diǎn shuì jiào
enemy.en: What time did you go to sleep yesterday?
enemy.fr: Tu t'es couché à quelle heure hier ?

player.pinyin: wǒ zuó tiān hěn wǎn shuì jiào
player.en: I went to sleep very late yesterday.
player.fr: Je me suis couché très tard hier.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān lèi bú lèi
enemy.en: Are you tired today?
enemy.fr: Tu es fatigué aujourd'hui ?

player.pinyin: yǒu yì diǎn lèi xiǎng shuì jiào
player.en: A little tired, I want to sleep.
player.fr: Un peu fatigué, j'ai envie de dormir.

enemy.zh: 你昨天晚上有沒有加班？
enemy.pinyin: nǐ zuó tiān wǎn shang yǒu méi yǒu jiā bān
enemy.en: Did you work overtime last night?
enemy.fr: Tu as fait des heures supplémentaires hier soir ?

player.pinyin: méi yǒu wǒ zhǔn shí xià bān
player.en: No, I finished work on time.
player.fr: Non, j'ai fini le travail à l'heure.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān shàng bān chí dào le ma
enemy.en: Were you late for work today?
enemy.fr: Tu es arrivé en retard au travail aujourd'hui ?

player.pinyin: duì a sè chē le bào qiàn
player.en: Yeah, there was traffic, sorry.
player.fr: Ouais, il y avait des embouteillages, désolé.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān yǒu méi yǒu kāi huì
enemy.en: Did you have a meeting today?
enemy.fr: Tu as eu une réunion aujourd'hui ?

player.pinyin: yǒu huì yì hěn wú liáo
player.en: Yes, the meeting was boring.
player.fr: Oui, la réunion était ennuyeuse.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái hěn lèi
enemy.en: You look tired today.
enemy.fr: Tu as l'air fatigué aujourd'hui.

player.pinyin: duì a wǒ zuó tiān áo yè
player.en: Yeah, I stayed up late yesterday.
player.fr: Ouais, j'ai veillé tard hier.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān yào bú yào yùn dòng
enemy.en: Are you going to exercise today?
enemy.fr: Tu vas faire du sport aujourd'hui ?

player.pinyin: xiǎng a kě shì wǒ hěn lèi
player.en: I want to, but I'm really tired.
player.fr: J'ai envie, mais je suis très fatigué.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ xià bān yǐ hòu yào gàn má
enemy.en: What are you doing after work?
enemy.fr: Tu fais quoi après le travail ?

player.pinyin: wǒ yào gēn péng yǒu liáo tiān
player.en: I'm going to chat with a friend.
player.fr: Je vais discuter avec un ami.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān guò de zěn me yàng
enemy.en: How was your day today?
enemy.fr: Ta journée s'est passée comment ?

player.pinyin: hái bú cuò zhǐ shì yǒu diǎn máng
player.en: Pretty good, just a bit busy.
player.fr: Plutôt bien, juste un peu chargé.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ píng cháng hěn wǎn huí jiā ma
enemy.en: Do you usually get home late?
enemy.fr: Tu rentres tard d'habitude ?

player.pinyin: bú huì wǒ hěn zǎo huí jiā
player.en: No, I get home early.
player.fr: Non, je rentre tôt.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ shì bú shì hěn lèi
enemy.en: You're tired, aren't you?
enemy.fr: Tu es fatigué, non ?

player.pinyin: duì a wǒ xiǎng shuì jiào le
player.en: Yeah, I want to go to sleep.
player.fr: Ouais, j'ai envie d'aller dormir.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ zuó tiān hěn wǎn cái huí jiā
enemy.en: You didn't get home until really late yesterday.
enemy.fr: Tu n'es rentré que très tard hier.

player.pinyin: duì a zuó tiān tài rè nào le
player.en: Yeah, yesterday was too lively.
player.fr: Ouais, hier c'était trop animé.

enemy.zh: 你比較想睡覺還是運動？
enemy.pinyin: nǐ bǐ jiào xiǎng shuì jiào hái shi yùn dòng
enemy.en: Would you rather sleep or exercise?
enemy.fr: Tu préfères dormir ou faire du sport ?

player.pinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xiǎng shuì jiào xiè xie
player.en: I'd rather sleep, thanks.
player.fr: Je préfère dormir, merci.

enemy.zh: 你今天早點睡覺，好不好？
enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān zǎo diǎn shuì jiào hǎo bù hǎo
enemy.en: Go to bed early tonight, okay?
enemy.fr: Couche-toi tôt ce soir, d'accord ?

player.pinyin: hǎo a wǒ yě hěn kùn le
player.en: Okay, I'm sleepy too.
player.fr: D'accord, j'ai sommeil aussi.

enemy.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān jīng shen hěn hǎo ye
enemy.en: You seem really energetic today!
enemy.fr: T'as l'air en pleine forme aujourd'hui !

player.pinyin: yīn wèi jīn tiān shì zhōu mò
player.en: Because it's the weekend!
player.fr: Parce que c'est le week-end !

enemy.pinyin: wǎn ān zuò gè hǎo mèng
enemy.en: Goodnight, sweet dreams!
enemy.fr: Bonne nuit, fais de beaux rêves !

player.pinyin: wǎn ān nǐ yě shì
player.en: Goodnight, you too!
player.fr: Bonne nuit, toi aussi !
